subject.title: PR1/5 durable core: residual-gap RFC docs

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a separate durable-core residual-gap architecture boundary alongside the existing TaskFlow/database-first owners?
rationale: The patch is technically clean, but repository policy and current TaskFlow behavior do not determine whether these cross-owner invariants deserve a new official architecture surface or should remain within existing owners.

options.title: Sponsor and reconcile
options.body: Approve the separate proposal only after a TaskFlow owner confirms its precise non-overlapping responsibilities and downstream implementation boundaries.

options.title: Fold into TaskFlow
options.body: Move the accepted residual invariants into the existing TaskFlow architecture and operator documentation instead of creating a parallel durable-core concept.

options.title: Keep as discussion
options.body: Leave the proposal in PR or issue discussion and do not publish it in official documentation until the architecture direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and reconcile
recommendation.body: Approve the separate proposal only after a TaskFlow owner confirms its precise non-overlapping responsibilities and downstream implementation boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged TaskFlow substrate is the closest established owner boundary and was introduced through their prior work.
